name: axe DevTools
summary: Runs automated WCAG accessibility checks (including color-contrast rules) inside the browser and walks you through failures with guided tests.
price: Freemium (free core; paid Pro tier per deque.com)
license: Proprietary; store page links Deque's terms of use for the extension (deque.com/terms-of-use/axe-ext).
goodFor: Running automated WCAG checks, including contrast, and fixing failures one by one.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: axe accessibility wcag contrast checker automated audit deque
